label: brute_force
description: Anomalous authentication failures on SSH service. 412 failed logins in 5 minutes from a single source across 37 usernames, followed by one successful login for user admin.

label: brute_force
description: Spike in failed RDP logon events from external address. Password spraying pattern: 1 attempt per account over 150 accounts, 160 failed logins per minute.

label: ddos
description: Inbound packet rate on web gateway rose from 8k to 1.2M packets per second. 94 percent of flows are TCP SYN with no ACK, 310k half-open connections, request timeouts reported.

label: ddos
description: Volumetric UDP flood toward DNS server, 22 Gbps inbound from thousands of sources with identical 64 byte payloads. Service latency above 5 seconds.

label: port_scan
description: One external source sent SYN packets to 1,024 ports across 40 hosts in 90 seconds. 98 percent of connections reset or unanswered, under 60 bytes per flow. Sequential port ordering.

label: port_scan
description: Internal workstation probing many hosts on SMB and RDP ports. 250 hosts contacted in 2 minutes, almost all connections reset. Host has no history of network scanning.

label: sql_injection
description: Web application firewall flagged requests to /products?id= containing UNION SELECT and OR 1=1 payloads. 380 requests with varying payloads in 4 minutes, database error messages returned in responses.

label: sql_injection
description: Login endpoint received parameters with quote characters, SLEEP(5) time delay and comment markers. Response times of exactly 5 seconds suggest blind injection by an automated tool.

label: data_exfiltration
description: Internal file server uploaded 38 GB to an unfamiliar external cloud storage address at 02:40, roughly 90 times the normal daily outbound volume. Traffic is an encrypted compressed archive.

label: data_exfiltration
description: Employee laptop sent 6 GB over FTP to a foreign IP address after hours. Prior 30 days showed no FTP use. Many zip archives of documents transferred.

label: c2_beaconing
description: Host connects to the same external IP every 60 seconds with 212 byte payloads, jitter below 2 percent, for 14 hours. Destination appears on a threat intelligence command and control list.

label: dns_tunneling
description: One host issued 48,000 DNS TXT queries to a single domain in one hour. Subdomain labels are 52 characters of random looking text with high entropy, responses larger than 400 bytes.

label: privilege_escalation
description: Standard user svc-report was added to the Domain Admins group and then logged on to 11 servers within 10 minutes. Credential dumping tool execution observed on the originating host.

label: benign
description: Outbound transfer of 120 GB from backup server to storage array started at 01:00. Matches the nightly scheduled backup job listed in the change calendar.

label: benign
description: Port sweep of 1,000 ports across the subnet from the security team scanner during the approved quarterly vulnerability assessment window.

label: benign
description: Three failed SSH logins for user jsmith followed by a successful login two minutes later. Single source, normal working hours.

label: benign
description: Web traffic doubled to 40k requests per second after the marketing email campaign launched. Request mix and user agents look normal and all connections complete.

label: benign
description: Server downloaded 9 GB from the software update mirror. Matches the monthly patch deployment window.
